title: Legacy Kuldra Skip with a Shortcut to the Heart (Patched?) | RS: Dragonwilds 1.0.0.6
author: Tiger with the Bars
description:
Is the Kuldra skip patched? Are other methods still in play? Check the comments for ongoing discussion as this may change.

Skip the grueling Kuldra boss fight entirely and head straight to the Heart with this RuneScape: Dragonwilds speedrun technique! Follow along as we study legacy steps and positioning used to pull off this game-changing shortcut.

Credit: Zilko (.zilko)
